notes.title: Update 0.1.4
notes.content:
The camera angle was pulled back.
 Minor errors were fixed.
 Translations were made more natural.

notes.title: Update 0.1.3
notes.content:
Daily Progress System Added
 Minor Bugs Fixed
 Billing System Improved and Simplified
 Fixed Employee Registration Issue
 Removed Level System – Now Progress is Daily

notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where newly purchased shops would disappear.
 Fixed the bodyguard problem in shops.
 Thieves are now easier to chase away.
 Fixed the bug where the antique hunter kept bringing free items.
 Minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Demo Now Available – Step into the World of Antique Trading!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that the demo of Metawork: Antique Shop Simulator is now live on Steam!
In this sneak peek, you’ll get the chance to:
🕰️ Run your own antique store
💼 Buy, restore, and sell unique historical items
🔍 Discover the stories behind each piece
💬 Interact with customers and build your reputation

This is just the beginning! Your feedback will help us fine-tune the full game.
Try the demo now and let us know what you think.

💡 Don’t forget to add the game to your Wishlist and join our community!
